entries.principle: Anchor the opening in instantly recognisable psychological friction
entries.execution_guidance: Within the first two seconds, depict a low-stakes situation that triggers immediate viewer recognition
entries.dedup_note: Earlier register includes everyday friction in first three seconds; adds emphasis on viewer empathy and first two seconds

entries.principle: Escalate friction linearly, then release it through the product
entries.execution_guidance: Make each beat increase discomfort slightly so the resolution feels like emotional relief

entries.principle: Use medium close-ups and shallow depth of field for micro-expressions
entries.execution_guidance: Keep expressions sharp and setting legible but visually unobtrusive

entries.principle: Change focal length to match emotional or spatial shifts
entries.execution_guidance: Use tighter framing for intimacy and wider frames to establish environmental freedom

entries.principle: Build controlled naturalism with soft practical-motivated light
entries.execution_guidance: Mimic window or street lighting; preserve natural skin tones and subtle shadows
Support believable action through subtle clothing, environment and tactile interaction sounds
entries.dedup_note: Earlier register already includes everyday Foley; adds restraint and fine-grain ambience

entries.principle: Dip ambient sound at a reaction beat
entries.execution_guidance: Briefly lower music or background audio to focus attention on a facial response or punchline
entries.dedup_note: Earlier Gemini register already includes audio beat drops

entries.principle: Let score or voiceover support dialogue and swell at resolution
entries.execution_guidance: Keep dialogue dominant; use crescendo to underscore the product payoff

entries.principle: Cast and direct for ordinary human behaviour
entries.execution_guidance: Use relatable posture, unchoreographed body language and avoid commercial stereotypes
Direct natural pauses, sighs or quick glances rather than theatrical reactions
entries.dedup_note: Earlier register includes physical reaction before dialogue; adds hesitation and naturalism

entries.principle: Treat product use as a natural character action
entries.execution_guidance: Shoot phone interactions at realistic eye-level or over-the-shoulder angles with practical reflections
entries.dedup_note: Earlier register already covers natural OTS product UI integration
